title: Prevented mixed-period ratio calculations
points: Profit-and-loss ratios with multiple components now use a complete same-method component set, so a flagged LTM revenue row cannot be silently replaced with a different-period revenue row while the numerator stays on the original LTM method.
Rebuilt production D1 ratios and refreshed data-quality flags. The deterministic pipeline gate now reports 52 pipeline quality flags across 32 warning tickers before SCS reference cautions.
